title: Hikers photograph diamond-shaped craft, men in black follow

tellings.quote: two witnesses were out hiking. They then saw a large diamondshaped craft hovering.

plain: Two people out hiking are said to have seen a large diamond-shaped craft hovering and photographed it, and afterwards were followed by "men in black", the mysterious visitors UFO witnesses say come to them. The filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this as the witnesses told it to him. If true, it would mean someone was keeping watch on the sighting and on the people who saw it.
